summary: Implemented a single configurable SITE_NAME and used it for both the only visible landing-page text and for setting document/head metadata (title and Open Graph title) at runtime. Also added extra description metadata beyond the minimum requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Adds/updates additional metadata tags (meta name="description" and meta property="og:description") in addition to the requested minimum (title and og:title).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-10 only requires at minimum title and og:title; description metadata was not requested.
